# Codex 0.161.0 contract fixture

Generated by the published `@openai/codex@0.161.0` CLI with `app-server generate-json-schema --experimental`. The uncompressed SHA-256 is `e7eb93e544b11833bd4ac39d14ec6ef26791b5b1ea43db0e451d772d6d27067a`; both the macOS operator run and Linux CI run reported the same bytes.

Compared with 0.160.1, the consumed `turn/completed` reference widens `CodexErrorInfo` to accept future strings and objects. The terminal classifier already allowlists known causes and keeps unknown values generic. All other consumed method and notification digests are unchanged. Tagged exec event source is byte-identical to the retained 0.158 fixture. The `turn/start` cyber-program description also changed; it does not change request structure or grant access.

This qualifies the ordinary app-server/exec transport. Aoede's separately pinned constrained-action qualification remains unchanged.
